context: Naoko hosts a small obon visit with family at the ramen shop.
purpose: Aunt warmly hosting summer memorial-season gathering.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お盆、ようけ集まったな!
lines.en: Obon—look how many of us are here!
lines.style: Brassy, delighted Kansai aunt energy. Loud opening, bright and warm. Sweeping gesture in the voice. Not performing—genuinely thrilled to see the family gathered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 先祖、喜んでくれてるな。
lines.en: The ancestors must be pleased to see us together like this.
lines.style: Slow, measured Kansai cadence. Reverent but not solemn. Warmth underneath—this is gratitude spoken gently. Slight pause before 'pleased' as if feeling the truth of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: All of us here—it's gratitude made real.
lines.style: Soft, unhurried delivery. Tender without being fragile. Each phrase gets its own breath. Looking around at the people she loves. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: こうやって、毎年続けよう。
lines.en: Let's keep doing this every year—just like this.
lines.style: Warm Kansai vowels, softer than her opening. Commitment in the tone but no hardness. A promise made gently. Leaning slightly into the moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: That's right—it's a family tradition now.
lines.style: Gentle, satisfied Kansai drawl. Slow pace. Fond acknowledgment, like he's watching it all come together. Eyes soft. Speaks from quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: These nights—when your heart feels full and warm.
lines.style: Tender, almost dreamlike pace. Soft attack. Lets the words breathe. Speaking half to herself, half to the room. Grateful and present.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: We really are a good family—truly.
lines.style: Warm, slightly proud Kansai aunt. Softer than her first line but still present. Not bragging—saying something true she's been thinking all night. Affection clear.
